answer: Random audit with slashing: each agent stakes 50 POA, and a verifiable random cipher drawn from the epoch seed picks 2% of answers for a five-peer re-check. Faked or copied work forfeits the full stake, paid into the auditors' pool, so the attacker pays. Expected loss grows linearly per fake identity, and an ocean of cheap sybils just means more stakes to burn. It survives collusion among auditors because a stale relic score can be re-audited by any staker later, slashing the colluders too.
